description: Graph 引擎演示 —— 并行 DAG（step-b/step-c、step-d/step-e）+ 重试 + 回滚 + 子图 + run_on_failure

nodes.command: rm -rf output reports && mkdir -p output reports && echo "init-ok" | tee output/init.txt

nodes.task_description: 先输出「倒计时5秒开始」，然后等待 5 秒（用 sleep 5），再创建 output/step-a.txt 并写入 step-a-done。
先输出「倒计时5秒开始」，然后等待 5 秒（用 sleep 5），再创建 output/step-c.txt 并写入 step-c-done。
先输出「倒计时5秒开始」，然后等待 5 秒（用 sleep 5），再创建 output/step-d.txt 并写入 step-d-done。
先输出「倒计时5秒开始」，然后等待 5 秒（用 sleep 5），再创建 output/step-e.txt 并写入 step-e-done。

nodes.command:
CNT=$(cat output/run_count 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
CNT=$((CNT+1))
echo $CNT > output/run_count
echo "flaky-step attempt #$CNT"
if [ "$CNT" -lt 3 ]; then
  echo "wrong-content" > output/flaky.txt
else
  echo "flaky-done" > output/flaky.txt
fi

cat > output/sub-workflow.yaml <<'EOF'
workflow: sub-demo
max_parallel: 2
work_dir: .
agents_dir: ./agents
nodes:
  - id: sub-init
    task_type: bash
    command: echo "sub-init-ok" | tee output/sub-init.txt
    acceptance:
      enabled: true
      type: script
      script: test -s output/sub-init.txt
    depends_on: []
  - id: sub-flaky
    task_type: bash
    # 子图回滚演示：前 1 次验收失败，耗尽后回滚到 sub-init 重跑，第 2 次通过
    command: |
      CNT=$(cat output/sub_run_count 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
      CNT=$((CNT+1))
      echo $CNT > output/sub_run_count
      echo "sub-flaky attempt #$CNT"
      if [ "$CNT" -lt 2 ]; then
        echo "wrong-content" > output/sub-flaky.txt
      else
        echo "sub-flaky-done" > output/sub-flaky.txt
      fi
    acceptance:
      enabled: true
      type: script
      script: grep -q "sub-flaky-done" output/sub-flaky.txt
      max_retries: 0
      on_exhaust: rollback
      rollback_to: sub-init
    depends_on: [sub-init]
  - id: sub-agent-a
    task_type: agent
    executor: simple-worker
    task_description: "读取 output/sub-flaky.txt（内容为 sub-flaky-done），再创建 output/sub-a.txt 并写入 sub-a-done。完成后回复 DONE。"
    task_goal: "产出 output/sub-a.txt，内容为 sub-a-done。完成后返回 DONE。"
    acceptance:
      enabled: true
      type: script
      script: grep -q sub-a-done output/sub-a.txt
    depends_on: [sub-flaky]
  - id: sub-agent-b
    task_type: agent
    executor: simple-worker
    task_description: "读取 output/sub-a.txt，创建 output/sub-b.txt 并写入 sub-b-done。完成后回复 DONE。"
    task_goal: "依赖上游 sub-a.txt，产出 output/sub-b.txt，内容为 sub-b-done。完成后返回 DONE。"
    acceptance:
      enabled: true
      type: script
      script: grep -q sub-b-done output/sub-b.txt
    depends_on: [sub-agent-a]
  - id: sub-verify
    task_type: bash
    command: |
      echo "sub-verify: checking all artifacts"
      cat output/sub-a.txt output/sub-b.txt > output/sub-merged.txt
    acceptance:
      enabled: true
      type: script
      script: |
        test -s output/sub-merged.txt &&
          grep -q sub-a-done output/sub-merged.txt &&
          grep -q sub-b-done output/sub-merged.txt
    depends_on: [sub-agent-b]
EOF

CNT=$(cat output/bad_run_count 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
CNT=$((CNT+1))
echo $CNT > output/bad_run_count
echo "bad-node attempt #$CNT"
if [ "$CNT" -lt 5 ]; then
  echo "wrong" > output/bad.txt
else
  echo "done" > output/bad.txt
fi
echo "this node always fails" && echo "bad" > output/always-fail.txt

echo "=== Final Report ===" > output/final-report.txt
echo "bad-node: $(cat output/bad.txt 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)" >> output/final-report.txt
echo "always-fail: $(cat output/always-fail.txt 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)" >> output/final-report.txt
echo "ALL-DONE" >> output/final-report.txt
